sentences.text: 10. The appellant has been convicted for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(h) and (n)/506 of the IPC and Section 5(j)(ii) and (l) read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

The appellant has been sentenced to undergo 20 years of rigorous imprisonment for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(h) & (n) of the IPC alongwith fine of Rs. 50,000/- and a further simple imprisonment for a period of 01 year in default of payment of fine.

The appellant has also been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 2 years for the offence punishable under Section 506 of the IPC alongwith fine of Rs. 10,000/- and a further simple imprisonment for 3 months in default of payment of fine.

11. Admit.
12.

15. Issue notice.

Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.
